title: Minimum Swaps to Make Strings Equal
description: Calculate minimum swaps to make s1 and s2 equal by counting xy and yx mismatches.
pseudocode:
1. Count xy and yx mismatches
2. If (xy + yx) is odd, return -1
3. Calculate swaps: (xy // 2) + (yx // 2) + (xy % 2) * 2
4. Return total swaps

steps.note: Initialize mismatch counters for s1='xx', s2='yy'. Finding xy and yx counts.
Scanning index 0: s1[0]='x', s2[0]='y'. Mismatch type: xy. xy=1, yx=0.
Scanning index 1: s1[1]='x', s2[1]='y'. Mismatch type: xy. xy=2, yx=0.
Check if total mismatches (2 + 0 = 2) is odd. It is even, proceed.
